guards: the nuclear determinant lane uses the new weighted c0 branch carrier W^0_1, not the larger II-KE weighted sup carrier W_1
pressure derivative concerns the geometric potential -s log|G'| and is not identified with the Khinchin observable kappa=log a1
Nisoli certified eigenvalues/projectors are source-bound external certificates; this script audits functional transport and exact constants, not the Arb spectral computation

pressure_derivative.geometric_family: L_s f(x)=sum_{n>=1}(n+x)^(-2s) f(1/(n+x)); cross-space branch majorants converge locally uniformly for Re(s)>3/4, giving an analytic trace-class family after restriction
pressure_derivative.integral_identity: P'(1)=-int log|G'| dmu = -int_0^1[-2 log x]/[log2(1+x)] dx = -pi^2/(6 log2)

source_hardy_trace_class.source_result: Nisoli Theorem 4.10/Corollary 4.11: approximation numbers <= C2(2/3)^(m-1), hence L1 and L3/2 are trace class with trace norm <=3 C2

spectral_determinant.equality: D_W(z)=D_H(z) as normalized canonical products because AB/BA gives the same nonzero eigenvalues with algebraic multiplicities and both sequences are absolutely summable
spectral_determinant.hardy: D_H(z)=det(I-z L1) is defined because L1 is trace class
spectral_determinant.weighted: D_W(z)=det(I-z T) is defined on W^0_1 under the nuclear/MAP construction
spectral_determinant.zero_set: zeros are z=lambda_j^{-1} for the nonzero GKW eigenvalues

weighted_c0_branch_carrier.B: B:W^0_1->H2(D3/2) is bounded by C1=sum sqrt(2n+1)(1+log n)/(n-1/2)^2
weighted_c0_branch_carrier.J: J:H2(D1)->W^0_1 bounded because ||f o tau_n||<=sqrt(2n+1)||f|| and (1+log n)^(-1)->0
weighted_c0_branch_carrier.approximation_property: weighted c0-sum carrier has the metric approximation property inherited from c0 of Hilbert blocks
weighted_c0_branch_carrier.definition: W^0_1={branchwise germs f: ||f o tau_n||/[sqrt(2n+1)(1+log n)] ->0, with weighted sup norm}
weighted_c0_branch_carrier.factorization: T=J S B on W^0_1; S is nuclear and J,B are bounded, hence T is nuclear/compact
weighted_c0_branch_carrier.kappa: kappa o tau_n=log n, so normalized branch norm tends 0 and kappa in W^0_1
weighted_c0_branch_carrier.restriction_S: S:H2(D3/2)->H2(D1) has singular values (2/3)^m, m>=0, and trace/nuclear norm 3
